description: This PHP class models a list of attendance records, providing serialization to array format for API responses. It encapsulates attendance data including punch-in and punch-out times, notes, and duration calculations, utilizing traits for date/time and number formatting.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordListModel
classes.description: A model representing a list of attendance records, capable of serializing data for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the model with an array of attendance records.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the attendance records into an array suitable for API output.
